techs.name: The Ashtear Paradox
techs.notes: Krona form (blood and oil), Ch3. 3.2 total over 12 hits; time stop. Blood and oil magnetized into a singularity, struck from opposite timelines: a miniature Big Bang of watercolour gold, sumi-e crimson and liquid metal. +50% while Crono's galaxy is open. High Cassia Synergy triggers Lucca's final schematic (Reinforced for 3 jumps).

techs.name: The Ashtear Paradox
techs.notes: Sera form (family), after the U2 consent quest (read as Lucca_Consent Asked). The family volley, the Fair theme warped on the gramophone. Same rules as the Krona form; shares its effect hook.

techs.name: First Light That Never Was
techs.notes: Full form after Ch5 (written as Ch6). 1 genesis hit, map-wide light. What if Lavos never fell: heals the party for what it deals; +100% healing in U3. The Scholar route's U3 true-ending key.

techs.name: First Light That Never Was — Fragment I
techs.notes: Fragment I (Crono + Cassia-09 + Xyloph), available in U3 from Ch4 at 50% power (1.5). Tags and Cassia's 8 MP are carried over from the full form; the bible gives neither.

techs.name: Chrono Laugh
techs.notes: First Light, Fragment II. Ch6 Prismatic (Re-String As Instrument). 2.6 total over 6 hits. Converts a shared shield into individual shields and auto-Breaks the smallest; heals the party 10%.

techs.name: Delta Storm
techs.notes: DELTA with edges up to 6.0; 3 x 3 hits, 2.8 total. Three Crono archetypes: false hero, evil daughter, the jester who took the curse. +30% if all three are below 30% HP. Glenn has two arms for the duration (phantom Cyrus).

techs.name: Carnival of Souls
techs.notes: Glenn inflates into the big top. Light refracts through the tent's stained-glass panels: +3 BP, which may exceed the cap by 1 until the end of the next ally's turn.

techs.name: Washi-Hollow Rebirth
techs.notes: CIRCLE + SELF_AURA Venn at Boost Lv3; no size given, CIRCLE 4.0 chosen. The three who learned cracks are where light gets in: full heal; every enemy in the Venn loses 25% of its current plates (+25% AoE); a 4-frame Perfect Frame input adds +15% gold-sheen damage to the next hit.

techs.name: Omega Triple
techs.notes: Final Dojo (Omega-Spekkio's recruitment, Ch8). 4 erasures, 3.5 total; origami unfold. Erases every resistance of everything inside for the rest of the fight; the party gains NULL SHIELD (20% damage reduction) for the fight.

techs.name: Family Porcelain — All Three Fathers
techs.notes: Ending 3 / True (Ch12). CIRCLE 7.0 + SELF_AURA 4.0 Venn. Reinforced: -80% Time Debt for the next 3 jumps; +2 Crono integrity; gold scatter. Light >= 60. The True Ending finisher.

techs.name: Fake Family Photo Real
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). The photo is real this time, so Crono needs no galaxy state: every ally inside is healed to at least 60% of max HP, Crono's Battle Strain -20%, and the party is Reinforced for the next gate jump.

techs.name: First Light That Never Was — Child Variant
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). The three of them build a block tower that collapses gently. Splits a shared shield or Mycelia pool back into individual shields and auto-Breaks every enemy left at 0; heals the party for what it deals.

techs.name: Promise Across Rust
techs.notes: Performed by Doan + Robo + R-66Y's child form (summoned); actors are the summoners. CIRCLE 8.0 + SELF_AURA 3.0 Venn. Cost also +1 BP (no engine key). Unlock: Seed of Doan grown + Arris_Dome_Sleeping + R-66Y_Rewound + 3 visits. Pay debt with care: +3 Crono integrity; plants a permanent garden in the U7 void (Glaze Erosion -15% everywhere).
